user_story: As a user, I want to submit a registration form with my personal details so that I can register successfully. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must have input fields for 'First Name' (id: 'firstName'), 'Last Name' (id: 'lastName'), 'Email' (id: 'userEmail'), 'Mobile Number' (id: 'userNumber'), 'Date of Birth' (id: 'dateOfBirthInput'), 'Subjects' (id: 'subjectsInput'), 'Hobbies' (checkboxes with ids: 'hobbies-checkbox-1', 'hobbies-checkbox-2', 'hobbies-checkbox-3'), 'Current Address' (id: 'currentAddress'), and a 'Submit' button (id: 'submit'). 2. Upon successful submission, the URL should change from 'https://demoqa.com/automation-practice-form'. 3. If the form is submitted without filling in the required fields, the URL should not change.
